title: U.S.-origin share of uranium for U.S. reactors, 2003-2025
source: Source: EIA Uranium Marketing Annual Report (Form EIA-858), ERW table eia_uranium_marketing_annual. Uranium bought by owners and operators of U.S. reactors. EIA published no U.S.-origin figure for 2019, 2020 and 2022.
squareNote: Each square: 1% of the uranium bought
